steps.en: Outstanding notices for today's batch are collected
steps.id: Notice outstanding untuk batch hari ini dikumpulkan

steps.en: Notices with the same company ID are spotted
steps.id: Notice dengan ID perusahaan yang sama dikenali

steps.en: All notices of one company are merged into one group
steps.id: Semua notice satu perusahaan digabung dalam satu kelompok
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates or stages stay in separate groups.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan due date atau stage berbeda tetap terpisah.

steps.en: One email lists the offences of that company
steps.id: Satu email memuat offence perusahaan itu

steps.en: Each unique company receives only one email
steps.id: Setiap perusahaan unik hanya menerima satu email
steps.why_en: Retries can resend the merged email once per notice, and the job is switched off.
steps.why_id: Retry bisa mengirim ulang email gabungan sekali per notice, dan job dimatikan.
